info.name: Society Management API
info.description:
Works against the dynamic-roles model (V3). Run the folders top to bottom, or the whole collection in the Runner — every request has a status assertion.

1. Auth logs in as the platform SUPER_ADMIN (Stan Lee) — everything in folders 2–6 runs with {{superAdminToken}}.
2–5 build a fresh society → wing → flat and create a SECRETARY, GUARD and RESIDENT in it (random phones, password Pass@123), saving every id.
6 logs in as those users; 7–8 exercise role assignment and role definitions; 9 checks what each role must NOT be able to do.

Existing local data: Nick Fury (9000000616 / Shield@616) is SECRETARY of Avengers Tower.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Login is open; every other endpoint needs a Bearer token.

exec: console.log("Logged in as", r.name, r.roles.map(x => x.role + (x.societyId ? "@" + x.societyId : "@PLATFORM")));

item.name: Login as Secretary (Nick Fury, Avengers Tower)

exec: console.log("Logged in as", r.name, r.roles.map(x => x.role + (x.societyId ? "@" + x.societyId : "@PLATFORM")));

item.name: 2. Societies
item.description: Creating a society needs SOCIETY.SETTINGS.CREATE at platform scope — SUPER_ADMIN only.

item.name: 5. Users
item.description: Every user is created with a first role. SOCIETY roles need societyId; RESIDENT also needs flatId (residentType optional: OWNER/FAMILY/TENANT).

item.name: 6. Log in as the new users
item.description: Uses the phones saved in folder 5.

exec: console.log("Logged in as", r.name, r.roles.map(x => x.role + (x.societyId ? "@" + x.societyId : "@PLATFORM")));

item.name: Guard registers FCM token on own profile
Secretary lists wings of own society
7. Role assignments
item.description: A user may only grant/remove roles below their own, in societies where they hold the permission.

item.name: Roles the secretary may assign here

request.description: Expect COMMITTEE, GUARD, RESIDENT — not SECRETARY or ADMIN.

item.name: Secretary makes the resident a committee member
8. Role definitions (Super Admin)
item.description: Platform-only: SYSTEM.ROLE.* / SYSTEM.PERMISSION.*. Creates a custom role, edits it, then deletes it so the folder can be re-run.

request.description: inherits = roles below it (it gets their permissions); includedIn = roles above it (they may assign it).

item.name: Secretary creates an ADMIN - higher rank (expect 403)
Secretary creates a society - platform only (expect 403)
Nick Fury reads this society - not his (expect 403)
Nick Fury views a user of this society (expect 403)
10. Complexes (Super Admin)
item.description: COMPLEX.SETTINGS.* is platform-only until it's decided what a complex shares.

item.name: 11. Cleanup (optional, destructive)
item.description: Deletes the flat and wing created by folders 3–4. Not needed for re-runs.
